fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance visible from both directions of approach on the street.
• Mark which driveway lane is entry and which is exit to prevent head-on blocking by arriving emergency vehicles.
• Keep the circular driveway clear of parked vehicles so apparatus can complete a full loop and exit without reversing.
• Trim vegetation along the access drive to maintain clearance to a height and width that allows a fire apparatus to pass without obstruction.
• Cut back dense vegetation that narrows or obscures the access drive so responders can see the full length of the drive on approach.
• Post visible signage or markings at the access drive identifying the locations of both detached structures.
• Install a clearly marked access point or gate on the rear perimeter fence to allow responders to reach the back of the property on foot without circling the main structure.
• Keep any rear gate unlocked or secured with a padlock compatible with a Knox Box or responder key system.
• Mark a designated staging area on the open lawn that keeps apparatus off the access drive and away from active work areas.
• Number or label both detached structures visibly from the driveway so responders can identify which building requires attention without searching the property.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin the tree cluster to create open space between individual trees and reduce the pathway for fire to move toward structures.
• Trim or remove shrubs that are growing directly against or immediately next to any structure in the cluster.
• Clear dead grass and dry ground cover within the areas closest to structures before fire season.
• Separate scattered shrubs from one another where they form connected patches near buildings.
• Keep low-hanging branches trimmed up on scattered trees near structures so flames cannot climb from ground cover into the tree canopy.
• Mow or cut grass cover near structures and along the edges of the open green space closest to buildings.
• Clear overhanging branches along the full length of the driveway so emergency vehicles can pass through without obstruction.
• Remove any shrubs or grass that has grown into the driveway margins and narrowed the usable width.
• In areas where vegetation grows close to structures with limited separation, pull shrubs and plants back from building walls, foundations, and vents.
• Keep the open areas between the structure cluster and surrounding vegetation free of accumulated dead plant material.
